Package game.actions

Class CapabilityToolAction<C,T extends HasStaminaCost>

java.lang.Object
edu.monash.fit2099.engine.actions.Action
game.actions.CapabilityToolAction<C,T>
Type Parameters:
C - the capability type required of the Ground (e.g. Tillable)
T - the tool type required in the Actor's inventory
Direct Known Subclasses:
TillAction, WaterAction
public abstract class CapabilityToolAction<C,T extends HasStaminaCost> extends Action
Abstract base class for an Action that requires an Actor to be carrying a specific kind of tool able to act on a Ground that exposes a matching capability (see canUseOn(T, C)), at a stamina cost determined by the tool by default (see staminaCost(HasStaminaCost, Object)).

Subclasses need only say which capability and tool types are involved, the failure messages, which of the Actor's tools can be used on which capability, and what the tool's effect actually does. Once the effect has been applied, this class also gives the tool a chance to fire any Enchantment attached to it (see EnchantmentTrigger), so a subclass never needs to know whether the tool it used happens to be enchantable. Every outcome this class reports also names the Location it happened at, so a subclass's own effect message only needs to say what happened, not where.

    • canUseOn

      protected abstract boolean canUseOn(T tool, C capability)
      Tells whether the given tool can be used on the given capability. Most tools can act on every instance of the capability they offer (compare BreakingTool.canBreak(game.positions.Breakable), which lets a tool refuse some targets) -- subclasses whose tool is always usable may simply return true.
      Parameters:
      tool - the tool being considered
      capability - the Ground's capability being acted on
      Returns:
      true if the tool can be used on this capability
